facts.text: Huntington's Forester Foundations curriculum includes The Core Four interdisciplinary courses, General Education, and three required Immersives.

sources.title: A New Academic Experience for a New Generation | Huntington University
sources.quote: Forester Foundations consists of three elements: The Core Four (HU-distinctive interdisciplinary courses), General Education (highly transferable, wide range of disciplines) and Immersives (three curricular/co-curricular experiences for all HU students).
